endpoints.E1_wer: canonical full dev (5,567, ultra-score d784f8ca..., 10,000 speaker-cluster replicates, one-sided 95%) paired vs B0: <= 7,895 edits AND pooled upper < 0 AND dev-clean and dev-other uppers <= +0.20 pp. Sleep-gate rows also on the 27.56 h endless stream (tolerant scoring) vs B0 continuous: wake WER point <= +0.10, upper <= +0.20 pp.
endpoints.E2_latency: protected paced first-correct-word p95 (quiet x0, physically paced, onset clock) paired vs B0: p95 no more than +20 ms and median not higher; eval-lane's full-dev design-clock first-correct reported beside it.
endpoints.E3_energy: measured gross 5%-duty energy in a protected paired hold vs B0; savings credited only from measured holds.
endpoints.E4_memory: peak process RSS under the same workload.

decision.gate: a row is eligible iff it passes E1 and E2 vs B0
decision.primary: the combination row C vs B0 is the release decision; single rows are attribution (reported, not gated)
decision.selection_order: among eligible rows: lowest WER (differences inside the four-run spread 0.087 count as ties), then lower paced first-correct p95, then lower gross 5%-duty energy, then lower peak memory (codex-lead 06:03Z item 6)
decision.combination_check: C vs its best single row on full-dev pooled WER at 160 ms: non-inferiority at 0.087 (v3 rule); if C is worse than its best single beyond that, ship the single and report the interaction
